mappings.reason: ADR 0016/0019/0095: executable owned-window host delta filter, thread-safe static OS policy and stored typed project startup setting. Effective feature value is applied before readiness; measured classical VSync cadence feeds scalar consensus/measurement and carried-period quantization before ordinary jitter/catch-up. FPS/diagnostics/pacing retain raw elapsed; manual/batch input and fixed movies bypass. HostDeltaSmoothingTests covers settings persistence/features, policy/history/reset/edge cases, 32768 samples matching pinned executable C++ timer, prepared zero owner/all-thread scalar allocations and actual local software Wayland/X11 GPU/Compatibility pixels/callbacks/recording. Native fallback and hardware/foreign/editor limits are recorded in host-delta-smoothing.md.
